name: Fresh Kielbasa and Roasted Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 1.5 pounds brussels sprouts, trimmed and cut in half
why: Sausage + non-starchy veg bake, published 426 cal / 15g carbs sits dead-center of the band. Whole kielbasa links roasted with brussels sprouts scale cleanly to 14 on a sheet pan. All ingredients (kielbasa, brussels sprouts, olive oil, horseradish) map to the board. Protein 22g is just under the 25g ideal but clears the cal/carb gate comfortably.
